why_now: People keep buying small, practical digital products when they save time: templates, research packs, prompt kits, checklists, and niche reports.
target_user: A creator or builder who wants a small product that can be researched, packaged, published, and improved repeatedly
first_test: Pick one niche, make one resource pack, publish one landing page, and collect real interest signals within 48 hours.
risk: The pack may be too generic unless the niche, pain point, and distribution channel are specific.
do_not_build: Do not build a marketplace. Test one paid resource pack first.
